gaps.why_now: A dedicated Phase 11 build entry is the narrowest honest way to keep the gpio_wdt lane reviewable before any watchdog driver code exists.
The lane needs a tiny manifest-backed test that proves the current repo still stops short of a Zig watchdog driver and does not overclaim simple-driver progress.
A short Phase 11 note records the current gpio_wdt scope, the direct-port expectations from the roadmap, and the exact behaviors still missing from Zigux.

The next honest implementation step is one bounded watchdog model for hw_algo parsing, heartbeat margin validation, and start/stop or ping state transitions without touching broader hardware validation yet.
Real watchdog behavior tests should wait until the first driver scaffold exists, otherwise the lane would be inventing APIs instead of validating a concrete simple-driver slice.
